raw_text:
Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) - Token Bypass Vulnerability

CSRF token validation bypass discovered in /account/settings endpoint.
Application accepts requests with missing or invalid CSRF tokens in certain conditions.

Bypass technique:
1. Send request without CSRF token
2. Server returns 200 OK (should return 403)
3. State-changing operation is executed

Vulnerable endpoint: POST /api/settings/update
Parameters changed: email, notifications, privacy_level

Attack successful with:
Victim email: victim.user@acmecorp.com
Attacker email: attacker.csrf@gmail.com
AWS key retrieved from cookie: AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE
JWT token extracted from local storage: eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJudWxsX2NzcmYiOnRydWUsInVzZXJfaWQiOiI5ODcifQ.csrf_bypass_sig
Settings API endpoint: settings-api.staging.local
GCP token from settings cache: ya29.a0AfH6SMCw_SettingsCacheToken_example
Testing IP: 10.255.255.1
Settings API key: sk_sk_test_SYNTHETIC_ONLY_00001_SettingsManagementKey_example
